title: Voice query panel loop
summary: A wordmark pill grows a mic button, a cursor taps it, the pill swells into a frosted panel where a spoken question resolves letter by letter, thinks, streams an answer and settles into a checked list, then folds back.
use_when: An assistant or search product whose hero moment is speaking a question
A loopable vertical clip for a landing page hero or a social feed
Showing the full ask, think, answer cycle in one calm continuous shot
A silent autoplay demo where the UI states carry the story

look.type_style: geometric grotesk wordmark with a small superscript tag, 2.5 % H; query in regular sans, sentence case, 1.5 % H, three lines; status and list labels in light grey, about 1 % H

sfx.event: each answer list item lands with its check
panel folds back into the pill

structure.shot: short wordmark pill top-left on a large frosted plate over a pale blue-violet gradient
structure.camera: near-static: plate fixed, pill widens; motion.json zoom 1.6 %/s from the pill
structure.motion: pill width grows about 25 %, springs.layout 8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a round mic button splits off the pill's right end; cursor enters from the right and taps it
structure.camera: near-static: plate fixed; motion.json zoom 2.1 %/s, pan -11 px/s from the split
structure.motion: button slides out of the pill, springs.ui 8 fr (±0.25 s); cursor springs in at 0.77, rests on the button 1.00 to 1.50, press at 1.77, springs.click (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: pill and button merge into one rounded panel that grows downward; gradient saturates; status label fades in at the bottom
structure.motion: panel height 1 to 1.6x, springs.layout 15 fr (±0.25 s); status label fade 8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the spoken question resolves letter by letter, three lines, about 11 words; listening label shimmers below
structure.camera: static plate; gradient drifts blue to violet
structure.motion: letters resolve left to right from blur with a soft trail, about 4 words/s, easings.outQuint per glyph (±0.25 s); label shimmer loop about 30 fr

structure.shot: question holds; status label swaps to a thinking state with a shimmer
structure.motion: label crossfade 8 fr (±0.25 s), shimmer sweep about 30 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a grey answer paragraph streams in under the question and scrolls upward inside a faded mask, then fades out
structure.motion: stream about 14 words/s, text scrolls up 1 line per 0.25 s, easings.linear; fade out 8 fr from 9.50 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: question alone in the panel, empty answer area; gradient pales to lilac
structure.camera: static plate; gradient fades toward pale lilac
structure.motion: no element motion; first list row starts to fade in at 11.77 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: answer as a checked list: three short place names, each with a small check, one under the other
structure.motion: rows land one per 1.25 s (12.00, 13.27, 14.50) with blur-in fade, easings.outQuint 8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a row of six small action icons appears under the list; full answer holds
structure.motion: icon row fades in 8 fr (±0.25 s); hold 1.75 s

structure.shot: panel content blurs out, panel collapses to a bar, splits back into pill plus mic button, button retracts
structure.motion: content blur-out 8 fr; panel height collapse springs.layout 15 fr; split at 18.00, button retracts 18.50 to 18.77 (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: only the wordmark pill remains, narrowing back to its opening width; matches the first frame for the loop
structure.motion: pill width shrinks about 15 %, springs.layout 15 fr (±0.25 s); then hold

params.brand: any brand.json: wordmark text and font, fg, muted, accent pair for the gradient, surface for the panel
params.content.question: spoken question, 8 to 14 words, wraps to 3 lines
params.content.answer: answer paragraph streamed then dropped, 40 to 80 words
params.content.items: 3 short answer rows, 1 to 3 words each, with checks
params.content.statusListening: label under the panel while listening
params.content.actions: number of action icons under the list (default 6)
params.timing.scale: stretch the whole 600 fr cycle; keep the loop by matching first and last frame
params.aspect: 9:16 default; 4:5 and 1:1 keep the panel top-left on the plate

notes: Single continuous shot, 0 cuts; all rows are UI state changes read from sheets at 0.25 s resolution. Loopable: 19.77 matches 0.00. No waveform is visible despite the catalogue hint; listening is shown only by a shimmering label. The answer paragraph is a red herring that streams and fades before the clean list lands. Background is an animated pastel gradient (blue, violet, lilac) moving behind a static frosted plate. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): voice-transcribe, pill-split. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
